root_cause.text: The error handling logic in `aml_sfc_dma_buffer_setup()` incorrectly manages DMA unmapping in failure paths: after a successful data DMA mapping, a subsequent info DMA mapping failure triggers an extra inline unmap of the data address that is then repeated in the fall-through cleanup, and the info unmapping uses the wrong length (`datalen` instead of `infolen`), leading to double-unmap and incorrect DMA synchronization.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the explicit `dma_unmap_single(sfc->dev, sfc->daddr, datalen, dir)` inside the error block for info mapping failure to prevent double-unmap, and changes `datalen` to `infolen` in the `out_map_info` label. It also replaces an unnecessary `goto` with a direct `return` after the first mapping failure.

spi: amlogic: add driver for Amlogic SPI Flash Controller

This driver provides support for the SPI mode of the Amlogic
bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit 4670db6f32e9379f5ab6c9bb2a6787cd9b9230a9
Author: Feng Chen <feng.chen@amlogic.com>
Date:   Wed Sep 10 18:18:26 2025 +0800

    spi: amlogic: add driver for Amlogic SPI Flash Controller
    
    This driver provides support for the SPI mode of the Amlogic
    Flash Controller. It supports both SPI NOR flash and SPI NAND
    flash. For SPI NAND, the Host ECC hardware engine can be enabled.
    
    The controller implements the SPI-MEM interface and does not
    support generic SPI.
bic_trace_step.reason: In `aml_sfc_dma_buffer_setup()`, the error path `out_map_info` at line A uses `datalen` instead of `infolen` for unmapping `sfc->iaddr` (wrong length). Additionally, in the info DMA mapping failure block (lines after `dma_mapping_error` for `sfc->iaddr`), there is an explicit `dma_unmap_single(sfc->dev, sfc->daddr, datalen, dir);` followed by `goto out_map_data;` which repeats the same unmap at line B, causing double-unmap of the data buffer. These are the exact vulnerabilities described.
